name: Lanes board: a declared lane wait state beside the checkpoint and one bounded lanes read
summary: A declared wait state beside a checkpoint, read by one bounded board that flags a stale wait. A checkpoint may carry an optional sibling lane_state key; the writer posts a reserved Kind: lane-state-v1 record with it, keeping the checkpoint object's field set closed; an older kit reads the record as ordinary text. Fields: schema_version 1, task, state, waiting_on (role or actor id; required with a waiting state, refused otherwise) and optional expect_by (ISO-8601 with offset; a past value is accepted and flagged). work lanes [--idle-minutes N] reads ONE native export plus the session registry: one row per lane keyed by its registered name, its held tasks with review_state/whose_move/next_actor from move_decision, the declared state, checkpoint age and the waiting_too_long/expect_by_passed/your_move_idle flags; idle lanes and the caller's own contributor-route row; bounded with next_offset. The record is part of the checkpoint written with it, so a declared wait never makes its own checkpoint read stale; one naming an older checkpoint or by another author still counts. An older kit reads it as ordinary text and reports the checkpoint stale until the next one (rollback).
